meanings.note: Unstressed first-person singular object; its exact direct/indirect/reflexive role depends on the verb.
Marks many specific human direct objects without a separate English word; in poco a poco it belongs to the expression little by little.
Stressed first-person singular pronoun after a preposition. Written with an accent, unlike possessive mi; may be doubled by unstressed me.
Also links tratar de + infinitive and forms more than with más de; these uses do not express possession.
